capabilities: Chat with the vault through an installed Codex CLI session
Organize, summarize, and edit notes, frontmatter, and links on request
Resume multi-turn Codex sessions and manage named conversations locally
Switch between read-only analysis and workspace-write sandbox access
Send active-note and text-selection context into the conversation
disambiguation: Not a workspace or layout manager; it is a chat panel that runs the Codex CLI against the vault.
extras: Early public beta (0.3.0): desktop-only, macOS/Linux only (Windows unverified), local filesystem vaults only, one Codex turn at a time. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Recommends keeping the vault under Git or a backup before editing tasks; installable via BRAT; SECURITY.md covers the threat model.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to converse with an AI agent that can read and edit the current vault, and other AI plugins require their own API keys.

relations.evidence: Codex runs through the CLI you already installed and signed into

summary: Side-panel chat that drives an existing Codex CLI login to organize, edit, and explore vault notes.
